summary: Auth cache security bug fix fully tested. All 13 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend login flow verified - correct user (System Administrator) displayed after login. Cache headers verified on all /api responses.

issues: DialogContent accessibility warnings - missing DialogTitle for screen readers (console warnings, not blocking)

Backend auth.py get_current_user validates impersonation tokens - checks if admin still exists and isn't blocked (lines 74-78)
Frontend fetchUser and refreshUser both send Cache-Control: no-cache header with requests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth cache security fix verified. 3 layers implemented: (1) NoCacheMiddleware adds no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate + Vary: Authorization, X-Main-Site-ID to all /api responses, (2) Frontend stale impersonation detection clears tokens with impersonated_by claim but no localStorage flag, (3) Backend validates impersonating admin still exists. Login returns correct user - 'System Administrator' for admkoodh@koodh.com credentials. Domain Manager and License Manager remain accessible.
